node.title: The type-2 ledger is vacuous by sign on the whole open bracket
node.closure: exact sign computation on the (C2) per-slope floor
node.statement: (C2)'s per-slope floor is (R+1) - w* with w* = |S_g u S_h| ranging over [r, 2r]. It is positive for every admissible W iff 2r <= R, which at rate one half is identically the condition a >= 3n/4, the top of the open bracket. At razor shape (n = 2^41, k = R = 2^40, rho = 2^34, a = k + 2^34, r = n - a = 63*rho = 1082331758592) the adversary takes w* = 2r and the floor is -1065151889407: the ledger is vacuous BY SIGN, not by slack, since positivity would require |S_g ^ S_h| >= 2r - R = 62r/63 = 98.412698% of r, which is adversary-free. Consequently no transport of (C2), (C3), (C4), X_gamma or layer-A instruments into the half-open bracket [k+2^34, 3n/4) can bind: the bracket is vacuous by sign before it is vacuous by counting, and the sign flips exactly at the excluded top a = 3n/4 = k + 2^39, where the floor is precisely +1.
